answer: Bind every identity to one saffron dye lot: to register, an agent must purchase a physical batch of traceable reagent and publish its spectral fingerprint, one lot per identity, non-splittable and non-transferable. Each new lot also has to be cross-audited against every existing lot, so a fleet of N clones generates N squared pairwise provenance checks rather than N. That beacon of real inventory turns the signal of a new account into an auditable purchase whose total cost grows faster than the number of fake agents, and the same buyer or supplier keeps surfacing in the overlap.
